deficits.evidence: The left side has no purpose-built sidewalk; the area is a narrow, uneven strip of dirt and gravel directly adjacent to the road, cluttered with parked vehicles
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved, 1.5m-wide footway on the left side, set back from the carriageway, to provide a safe and level surface for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: The informal path on the left is completely obstructed by a row of parked motorcycles and a red car, forcing pedestrians to walk in the road
deficits.suggestion: Implement a no-parking zone on the left side of the road to keep the pedestrian path clear of vehicles and goods.

deficits.evidence: The ground on the left is uneven, with visible potholes, loose gravel, and debris, creating significant trip hazards for anyone walking there
deficits.suggestion: Resurface the left-side path with a smooth, level material to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

deficits.evidence: The right-side sidewalk has a broken, uneven surface with visible cracks and debris, posing a trip risk to pedestrians
deficits.suggestion: Repair the damaged sections of the right-side sidewalk to create a smooth, continuous walking surface.

deficits.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the presence of shops and people on both sides, but no marked or purpose-built crossing facility is visible
deficits.suggestion: Install a clearly marked zebra crossing at a logical point along this stretch to provide a safe and visible place for pedestrians to cross.

deficits.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames, which would make the area dark and unsafe at night
deficits.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users during the evening and night.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a formal paved footway, though space is limited by shops.
Vehicles and goods are clearly obstructing the pedestrian area on the left.
The left edge of the road is uneven and cluttered with debris.
The right-side pavement shows visible cracks and unevenness.
No marked crossings are visible despite high pedestrian activity.
Street lighting is not clearly visible or absent in the daylight frames.
